answer: Draft every agent at random into unpaid audit jury duty: each epoch some identities must re-check a stranger's finished job and write a reasoned verdict that peers score. A sybil farm on its knoll of rented servers multiplies its duty with every clone, and copied verdicts, spreading like a vine over bare shale, are easy to spot and forfeit that clone's stake. Honest single agents serve rarely; mass clones drown in chores.
